description: Shared immutable activity or audit entry linked to a Tempo entity.

members.name: EntityRef
members.description: Entity this activity entry belongs to.

members.name: Actor
members.description: User that performed the action, when known.

members.name: Action
members.description: Action key, for example create, edit, or restore-version.

members.name: Timestamp
members.description: UTC timestamp when the activity occurred.

members.name: Before
members.description: Optional human-readable state before the change.

members.name: After
members.description: Optional human-readable state after the change.

members.name: CorrelationId
members.description: Optional correlation identifier used to group related activity entries.
